gholam.text:
ببین رفیق، اوضاع تو دنیای وب بدجوری به هم ریخته و خبر رسیده یه باگ امنیتی خفن و خطرناک توی هسته تمام نسخه‌های PHP پیدا شده که از راه دور هم قابل نفوذه. قضیه اون‌قدر بیخ پیدا کرده که قراره ۲۱ اکتبر جزئیات کامل این دو تا آسیب‌پذیری بحرانی با نمره وحشتناک ۹.۲ منتشر بشه و آپدیت اضطراری براش بیاد. کارشناسای امنیت به خط شدن و هشدار دادن هر کی برنامه‌ای رو سرور بالا داره که با PHP کار می‌کنه، باید همون ثانیه‌ای که وصله اومد سریع سرور رو آپدیت کنه یا کلاً تا وقتی پچ نکرده سایت رو موقتاً از دسترس خارج کنه تا کار دست خودش نده.

چرا مهمه؟ چون بیشتر سایت‌های اینترنت پایه و اساسشون رو همین PHP می‌چرخه و اگه ادمین‌ها نجنبن، هکرها کل سرورها و اطلاعات مردم رو رو هوا می‌زنن.

links.text:
Full details of a remotely exploitable vulnerability in the core engine of *all* PHP versions will be released tomorrow, October 21st. If your organization has internet facing PHP applications then you need to be ready to patch the minute the update is released or *strongly* consider taking the application offline until you can:

https://www.php.net/index.php#2026-10-20-1

quote.text:
🚨 PHP warns of two critical vulnerabilities as emergency patches arrive tomorrow

The PHP security team will release updates on October 21 at 14:00 UTC for two vulnerabilities, each rated 9.2 under CVSS v4.0.
⠀
Security researchers identified the flaws as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 and described them as remote code execution vulnerabilities reportedly affecting PHP versions 5 through 8.

PHP has not yet confirmed the affected versions, exploitation requirements or fixed releases.
⠀
The vulnerabilities were reportedly leaked before their planned disclosure. Researchers said they have not observed active exploitation, while PHP warned it may release the patches early if technical details become public or exploitation is detected.
⠀
Administrators should identify PHP installations now and prepare to apply the updates as soon as they become available.

links.title: PHP
links.description: PHP is a popular general-purpose scripting language that powers everything from your blog to the most popular websites in the world.
links.text:
We suggest you set session.upload_progress.enabled=0 until the
        next regular bugfix release, to fully protect from an unlikely RCE vector.
        This setting was already listed as a mitigation in the
        GHSA-6wmf-4rv5-p3rp
        advisory for CVE-2026-109619 published on Oct 21st, 2026. If you applied it
        then, keep it in place and no further action is needed.
      
        The issue can only occur under an unusual combination of configuration and
        application code. An application must set
        session.serialize_handler to php_binary or
        php_serialize in its configuration and then switch it to
        php at runtime with ini_set() before calling
        session_start(). Session upload progress must also still be
        enabled. Applications that never change the serialize handler at runtime can
        keep the feature enabled. Since this setup is unlikely in practice, we are
        handling it in the regular release cycle and will publish a full advisory for
        CVE-2026-115560 with the next release.
